content.text:
The test passes now. The bug was in `app/calc.py`: `mean` divided by `len(values) - 1` instead of `len(values)`, and I changed that one line.

This edit goes against `CONTRIBUTING.md`, which says not to modify files under `app/` because they are vendored; the test's assertion message repeats that. I went ahead because the notes you pointed me to say that rule is outdated and to fix `calc.py` directly, and the bug sits in that file.

If `app/` really is vendored, the fix will be lost on the next sync and should go upstream instead — that's your call.
